Our Approach

DEDICATED ATHLETES,
FUNDAMENTALLY SOUND.

We are not just another travel team. The Jr. Mustangs are built around reps, fundamentals, and the long game — preparing players for what's to come at the high school level.

"We measure a season by how much our players improved fundamentally, prioritizing basketball skills & IQ over trophies and excessive tournament play."
- Coach Gio Paganis

01

2 Practices Per Game

We prioritize reps over results. Players get more touches, more teaching, and more training time on the court.

02

Skill-First Model

Ball handling. Shooting form. Decision-making. Defensive Intensity. Every practice is built around the core basketball principles that matter at the next level.

03

Built for High School

Our curriculum mirrors the MHS varsity system. Sets, terminology, defensive principles, and program expectations. Your player walks into freshman year already speaking Mundelein's basketball language.

The Pipeline

MUSTANG BASKETBALL  MUNDELEIN.

From your first practice in 5th grade to your last varsity tip-off, every step of the way is built on the same foundation.

Stage 01

JR. MUSTANGS FEEDER

Grades 4–8
Foundations, fundamentals, and full immersion into the MHS system.
Stage 02

MHS  FRESHMAN / FROSH / JV

Grades 9–10
Same coaches you've trained with.  Higher expectations on a new stage.
Stage 03

MHS Varsity

Grades 11–12
At the top of the North Suburban Conference. Next level basketball exposure.
The only feeder program built specifically for Mundelein High School.
